name: SnapDebt
description: A high-stakes social debt tracker using photo evidence and geolocation to ensure you get paid back.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of total money owed and recent activity with animated progress rings.

features.name: debt-list
features.description: Swipeable list of active debts with neon status indicators.

features.name: stats-summary
features.description: Visual breakdown of total receivables using SVG charts.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll view with gradient header and sticky summary card.

screens.name: CreateDebt
screens.purpose: Capture evidence and log new debt entries instantly.

features.name: camera-capture
features.description: Take high-quality proof photos of receipts or items lent.

features.name: geo-tagging
features.description: Automatically attach current location to the debt record.

screens.layout: Step-by-step form with full-screen camera overlay and haptic feedback buttons.

screens.name: DebtDetails
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific debt with proof viewer and nudge actions.

features.name: nudge-trigger
features.description: Send aggressive reminders or share debt details to social apps.

features.name: proof-gallery
features.description: Zoomable image viewer for the captured debt evidence.

screens.layout: Parallax image header with glassmorphism action cards below.

screens.name: DebtMap
screens.purpose: Visualize where your money is scattered across the city.

features.name: debt-pins
features.description: Interactive map markers showing debt amounts at specific locations.

screens.layout: Full-screen interactive map with custom neon-styled map tiles and callouts.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage user settings, export data, and view personal credibility score.

features.name: data-export
features.description: Export your entire ledger as a structured file.

screens.layout: Clean list layout with toggle switches and account statistics.
